Lion Parcel (2025 - 2026)

Simplifying Complex Driver Workflows

Background

Lion Parcel is a logistics company providing domestic and international delivery services across First Mile, Sorting & Line Haul, and Last Mile operations.

As a Product Designer, I work across several logistics products and operational tools, including the Driver App, shipment booking, pickup operations, invoice management, and internal operational workflows.
I designed various solutions throughout my work, and here are some of the highlights.

Scope
Product Designer · Mobile
Industry
Logistics
Timeline
Q1 2026
Project 01

Simplifying Route Planning & Navigation

Couriers on Lion Parcel’s Driver App manage multiple stops per route, but the app only showed basic shipment details—not a clear overview of their route.

Drivers relied on Google Maps instead, manually copying customer addresses one by one to decide their next stop.

What I worked on
  1. 01Route Visibility

    Drivers had limited visibility of their overall delivery route and often had to check locations individually.

    I brought the current location, delivery stops, and route progress into one map, giving drivers a clearer view of their route at a glance.

  2. 02Route Planning

    Drivers needed a faster way to decide which delivery stop to visit next.

    I introduced stop prioritization by showing the 3 nearest delivery stops based on their current location, helping drivers quickly identify their next destination.

  3. 03Navigation

    Drivers previously had to copy customer addresses and switch to an external map to start navigation.

    I enabled direct navigation from the Driver App, allowing drivers to add or adjust location coordinates when a delivery point is missing or inaccurate. The corrected location can be saved for future deliveries, reducing the need to check the same location again.

Together, these improvements created a more connected route experience—from understanding the route to choosing the next stop and navigating to the destination.

Impact
↗30% Reduction in time to identify the next stop
↗25% Reduction in manual map checking
↗20% Reduction in time to start navigation

Project 02

Creating a Driver Dashboard

The Driver App homepage mixed operational actions with performance info, making key data hard to find. Usability testing surfaced two problems:

  • Mixed priorities — pickup, delivery, and earnings competed for space on one screen.
  • Hidden performance data — drivers had to dig through earnings just to see daily pickup/delivery counts.

I separated operational tasks from informational content, giving Pickup & Delivery dedicated spaces for action while introducing a new Dashboard to make key driver information easier to access.

What I worked on
  1. 01Driver Dashboard

    Introduced a new dashboard that gives drivers a daily overview of completed pickup and delivery tasks, helping them quickly understand their progress and track their workload throughout the day.

  2. 02Balance & Earnings

    Centralized balance and earnings information into one accessible space, so drivers can check their financial information without navigating through operational tasks.

  3. 03Task History

    Created a dedicated task history where drivers can review previous pickup and delivery activities, making it easier to track completed work and refer back to past tasks.

Impact
↗Daily Task Targets Made Visible
↗Completed & Pending Tasks Made Trackable

Driver Dashboard
Balance & Earnings

Project 03

Revamping Shipment Booking

Overview

Shipment booking at Lion Parcel supports both domestic and international shipments through a single booking form. The existing flow created two main challenges:

  • Repetitive data entry — Agents and POS handling regular senders had to re-enter the same sender information for every booking.
  • Unclear international requirements — New agents and POS staff needed to understand additional information required based on the destination country and customs requirements.

These challenges made the booking process slower and increased the risk of missing or incomplete information.

Root-cause Analysis

Identifying Friction in the Existing Booking Flow

I looked at the booking experience from two perspectives:

01
Recurring Bookings

How can we reduce the amount of information agents need to enter repeatedly?

02
International Shipments

How can we help agents understand what information is required without having to remember every requirement?

What I worked on
  1. 01Reduce Repetitive Input

    Enabled agents to save and reuse complete sender and shipment details for recurring bookings.

  2. 02Clarify Shipment Requirements

    Separated domestic and international forms to make the shipment context and required information more visible.

  3. 03Speed Up Form Completion

    Reworked the sender and recipient layout and simplified address input for easier copy-paste from sources like WhatsApp.

Impact
↗30% Faster Recurring Bookings
↗25% Clearer Shipment Requirements
↗20% Faster Address Input

Qubio AI Productivity Experience

Overview

Building an AI productivity experience is more than designing a chatbot. The challenge was understanding how people actually want AI to fit into their daily workflow.

Industry
AI
Company
DesktopIP
Project 01

AI-Powered Productivity Workflow

I conducted user research and usability testing to understand how users set goals, manage tasks, and build productivity habits.

I designed Qubio from 0 to launch, connecting personalized gamification, daily productivity tracking, and an AI-powered template community into one cohesive experience.

What I worked on
  1. 01Personalized Gamification

    Designed a gamification flow that uses user interests, habits, and needs to guide users toward relevant actions and encourage continued engagement. These user patterns can also be analyzed by AI to provide personalized recommendations.

  2. 02Daily Productivity Dashboard

    Designed a daily dashboard that brings key productivity information into one place, helping users focus on their tasks, goals, and daily progress.

  3. 03AI Template Community

    Designed a community experience where users can create, discover, and share AI templates based on different categories. Templates can also be used within groups to support discussion and task collaboration.

Impact
↗1,000+ Users Reached

Tokodistributor

Tokodistributor - Premium Reseller App & TikTok Seller Integration

Overview

Tokodistributor wanted to increase Basic Reseller conversion to Premium, but many users did not clearly understand the benefits or were unaware that the Premium program existed.

Industry
Marketplace E-commerce
Company
Tokodistributor
Project 01

Premium Reseller Conversion

Problem
01
Low Awareness

Many Basic Resellers were not aware of the Premium membership program.

02
Unclear Benefits

94% of users were only aware of around two Premium benefits, despite the program offering more.

03
Low Conversion

Users were interested but often hesitated to upgrade because they were unsure about the benefits and how to access them.

What I worked on

Awareness → Education → Conversion

  1. 01Premium Reseller Awareness

    Designed an in-site campaign to make the Premium program more visible across the platform.

  2. 02Benefit Discovery

    Designed a clearer way for users to explore and understand Premium benefits through dedicated content and banners.

  3. 03Conversion & Trust

    Designed supporting content such as member testimonials, social media, and WhatsApp contact to reduce hesitation and encourage users to upgrade.

Impact
↗20% More users followed up to join Premium
↗17% Increase in Premium Reseller interest in 3 months

Project 02

TikTok Seller Integration

Overview

Managing inventory across multiple platforms can quickly become complex. Suppliers needed a simpler way to connect their TikTok Seller stores, manage products, and keep inventory synchronized.

Problem
01
Manual Stock Updates

Suppliers had to manually update stock across platforms, increasing the risk of errors.

02
Stock Mismatch

Warehouse and TikTok stock could fall out of sync, leading to overselling.

03
Fragmented Product Management

Managing products across platforms created extra work and made the workflow harder to manage.

I designed an omni-channel integration between Tokodistributor and TikTok Seller, covering account connection, product management, and stock synchronization.

What I worked on

Connect → Manage → Sync

  1. 01Account Integration

    Simplified how suppliers connect their TikTok Seller stores with Tokodistributor.

    Connect → Authorize → Ready to use

  2. 02Product Synchronization

    Designed a simpler way to manage and upload products to connected TikTok stores.

    Manage → Review → Publish

  3. 03Stock Synchronization

    Designed an automated experience to keep product stock aligned across platforms.

    Sell → Update → Sync
